annotations.title: Rank pitches against an investment thesis

description: Rank PitchSpark pitches by how well they fit an investment thesis: either thesis text you pass, or the investor's saved thesis and preferences on PitchSpark (use_saved_thesis). Each result has a fit_score (0-100) and a rationale listing exactly which criteria matched. Use when: an investor asks "what fits my thesis". Prefer pitchspark_search_pitches_v3 for explicit filters. Do not use for: investment advice; the fit is a rule-based match, not a judgement. How it works (rule_based_v1, no model call): the thesis is read for sectors, stages, HQ regions and keywords (the same rules as search); a pitch earns points for each criterion it meets (sector 35, stage 25, region 10, keywords up to 30), scaled to the criteria the thesis names. Pitches that meet none are left out. Requires a PitchSpark API key (psk_...). The thesis text is never logged or stored. Returns {"pitches":[{card, fit_score, rationale}], "thesis", "method", "attribution"}. Up to 10 results (25 on a paid key). Each pitch this tool returns counts 1 against the daily pitch allowance (the one allowance every pitch tool shares), or 0 when the same API key (without a key, the same connection) already got that pitch today. Calls are logged, and each pitch returned is counted as a view.

limit.description: How many ranked pitches to return, 1 up to the caller's tier ceiling (10 on a free or anonymous call, 25 on a paid key). A higher value is reduced to the ceiling.

thesis_text.description: The thesis in plain English, 20 to 2000 characters. Not with use_saved_thesis.

use_saved_thesis.description: true: use the thesis and sector / stage / geography preferences saved on the key owner's PitchSpark profile. Not with thesis_text.

name: pitchspark_thesis_fit_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

pitchspark_score.description: PitchSpark's AI pitch score, 0 to 100, at any value; null when the pitch has not been scored.

thesis.description: The structured thesis that was matched: sectors, stages, regions, keywords, source.

title: Rank pitches against an investment thesis
